publisher.name: Nuxel Beta (local staging)
publisher.key_note: PUBLISHED TEST FIXTURE key. It is not a trust anchor; it signs nothing of value. Production catalogs must use a key whose private half never enters the repository.

policy.note: NuxTore is offline-first: it may only install packages staged in this repository. No network fetch, no store submission, no auto-install, no unsigned auto-install.

packages.name: NuxTore
packages.summary: Offline-first app catalog with signature and provenance checks
packages.description: NuxTore lists what the device already has and what the repository can stage. Every package carries a SHA-256 bundle digest, a provenance record and (normally) an Ed25519 signature; unsigned packages are refused unless the user turns on the unsigned-install policy and confirms each one by hand.

source.provenance: built in this repository during beta finalization (A32 baseline); no external publisher, no network fetch

packages.name: Media Player
packages.summary: Audio and video playback over the real playback path
packages.description: Plays local audio/video through the running playback service (PipeWire/ALSA on the handset, sample library offline) and shows the honest output route instead of claiming sound that was never heard.

packages.name: Media Downloader
packages.description: Adds URLs to a persistent queue and downloads them with resume, per-item checksums and a hard legal-use notice gate. No Google, Apple or Android service is contacted at any point.

packages.name: Authenticator
packages.summary: RFC 6238 TOTP with encrypted on-device secrets
packages.description: Standards-only TOTP (SHA-1/256/512, 6-8 digits, 30/60s). Secrets are encrypted at rest with AES-GCM under a passphrase-derived key, and never leave the device.

packages.name: Safe Cleanup
packages.description: Scans an explicit allowlist of cache/log paths, reports the exact reclaimable bytes and only deletes after a typed confirmation. Nothing outside the allowlist is ever touched.

packages.name: DevMgmt
packages.description: Shows what /sys and /proc actually report (USB, DRM/panel, touch, block, thermal, kernel). Read-only by default; privileged actions are labelled as privileged and require the Root & Sudo surface.

packages.name: SnekByte
packages.summary: The original SnekByte snake game, ported
packages.description: Faithful HTML5 port of the original Pygame snake game including WoNQ mode (a persistent obstacle every five foods), speed levels and the menu/settings/game-over flow.
packages.license: original SnekByte sources shipped without a licence file - see UPSTREAM-PROVENANCE.md

packages.name: PenguInterface
packages.description: Maps a device codename to its capabilities, quirks and required configuration documents, with strict isolation so one device's profile can never leak into another's.

packages.name: Live Console
packages.summary: Control centre over the SHA-256 verified live console
packages.description: Bounded command execution, unique request ids, real exit status, Ctrl-C cancellation and verified file pulls over the protected framed console protocol, plus status/navigation across home, settings, system and logs.

packages.name: Unsigned Demo Package
packages.summary: Deliberately unsigned entry used to prove the safety gate
packages.description: This entry ships WITHOUT a signature on purpose. NuxTore must refuse it by default, must never auto-install it, and may only install it after the operator enables unsigned installs and types the package id as a confirmation. It exists so the refusal path is exercised by the offline test suite, not just described.

source.provenance: test fixture — no publisher claims, no signature
